user.title: Choose your energy supplier
user.description: Pick your supplier to pre-fill the tariff values automatically, or choose "Anders / handmatig" to enter everything yourself. You can change all values later.

tariff.title: Tariff details
tariff.description: These values were pre-filled based on your supplier. Adjust anything that differs from your contract. Energy tax and VAT are national values.

abort.single_instance_allowed: KD Brain is already configured. Only a single instance is supported.

supplier.title: Choose your energy supplier
supplier.description: The tariff values will be pre-filled from this supplier on the next screen.

values.title: Tariff details
values.description: Tune the price source and tariff components used to compute all-in prices.

recalculate.name: Recalculate
recalculate.description: Force KD Brain to fetch the latest prices and recompute immediately.

price_source_unavailable.title: KD Brain cannot reach the price source
price_source_unavailable.description: KD Brain could not retrieve prices from {source}. It will keep retrying automatically; check your internet connection if this persists.
